subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should the permanent board contract support MCP-app widgets now, and if so which authorized rendering and capability-enforcement contract should gateway clients consume?
rationale: The branch adds a new persistent protocol and security boundary; choosing whether MCP-app widgets are supported, deferred, or represented through another existing surface is a product and API-contract decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Finish the unified board contract
options.body: Define the MCP-app render contract, add dashboard-tool creation/update actions, enforce approved network origins in CSP, and require end-to-end proof before landing.

options.title: Narrow the initial server domain
options.body: Ship only the HTML-widget contract after removing or explicitly rejecting MCP-app board content until a separately approved rendering design exists.

options.title: Pause the feature slice
options.body: Hold the persistent board protocol until the dashboard roadmap confirms the final client and security model.

recommendation.title: Finish the unified board contract
recommendation.body: Define the MCP-app render contract, add dashboard-tool creation/update actions, enforce approved network origins in CSP, and require end-to-end proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged board UI foundation and the linked dashboard design direction.
